head: Coloring with Farah: coloring book app for kids and adults on iPad
dek: Coloring with Farah is a new coloring app with seven picture-led story books and 127 pages for a one-time $9.99, no subscription. It was #31 among paid Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 15 November.
details: The books tell their stories through pictures, without written text, and the app is meant for ages 3 and up as well as adults; younger children may need help with saving and printing. You tap to fill an area or use a brush, zoom in and undo. Saved coloring stays on the device you used. It's made by Farah Jameel and Mahmood Alshekhli and came out on 12 November.
where: App Store, iPhone and iPad, $9.99 once
means: If your kids like coloring on a tablet, this one is paid once with no subscription and no extra books to buy.
todo: Look up Coloring with Farah on the App Store; remember that saved pages don't move to another device.
